theory.equations: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.
theory.states: Common release age/contact-consumption state; V0 proximity is stateless and has no pending-delay or turn-history mechanism. V1 additionally has contiguous per-target previous-boundary motion plus Fresh/Pending/Sealed fixed-delay state; resetRelease clears only the owning release state.
theory.inputs: Own sensor and target piecewise-linear captured paths with original offsets, native cutoff/contact coverage, this model radius/arming/lifetime and declared station.
theory.outputs: Validity, closest fraction/miss and trigger decision; World owns one causal captured-pose detonation and target attribution.
theory.discretization: Paths require first offset0 and strictly increasing finite offsets/positions. motionAt holds the final captured pose after path end. V0 bounds its sweep by eligibleEnd and own-path end, retaining target hold-at-last semantics for native stopped-target ownership; V1 additionally bounds by target-path end. These adapter semantics do not authorize inventing a future moving path; World supplies native target/contact/removal cutoffs.
theory.limits: Ideal geometric target detector, not RF/laser fuze electronics, scattering waveform, safe-arm mechanics or calibrated false alarm/discrimination. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: All23 swept-path cards share a software law, not sensor hardware; individual radius/lifetime and own release/target histories remain distinct.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.

theory.discretization: Paths require first offset0 and strictly increasing finite offsets/positions. motionAt holds the final captured pose after path end. theory.equations: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.
theory.states: Common release age/contact-consumption state; V0 proximity is stateless and has no pending-delay or turn-history mechanism. V1 additionally has contiguous per-target previous-boundary motion plus Fresh/Pending/Sealed fixed-delay state; resetRelease clears only the owning release state.
theory.inputs: Own sensor and target piecewise-linear captured paths with original offsets, native cutoff/contact coverage, this model radius/arming/lifetime and declared station.
theory.outputs: Validity, closest fraction/miss and trigger decision; World owns one causal captured-pose detonation and target attribution.
theory.discretization: Paths require first offset0 and strictly increasing finite offsets/positions. motionAt holds the final captured pose after path end. V0 bounds its sweep by eligibleEnd and own-path end, retaining target hold-at-last semantics for native stopped-target ownership; V1 additionally bounds by target-path end. These adapter semantics do not authorize inventing a future moving path; World supplies native target/contact/removal cutoffs.
theory.limits: Ideal geometric target detector, not RF/laser fuze electronics, scattering waveform, safe-arm mechanics or calibrated false alarm/discrimination. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.
theory.delta: aim-9m: selected version0, arming=1s, live end=45s, radius=10.0708305066m, delay=0s; captured CG sensor, zero delay, constrained-minimum sweep, explicit time-armed geometric scene independent of main seeker lock. Reticle receive law is newly selected; WDU17/B label does not establish the single-detector/spoke hardware. Historical passive-fin assertion abort was a fixture failure, not a warhead result.

sensitivity.effect: Radius uncertainty can flip the discrete decision; no smooth probability claim.
Timing and body-station uncertainty must be assessed with actual captured closing motion, not a scene-specific radius fit.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: All23 swept-path cards share a software law, not sensor hardware; individual radius/lifetime and own release/target histories remain distinct.
Time-armed geometric scene admits no RF/optical discrimination: a physically eligible decoy can trigger it.
V0 endpoint minimum differs materially from V1 actual-turn initiation; equal radius does not make AIM120D and AIM120C equivalent.
Capture gaps, removed-target cutoffs, arming/expiry tangencies and fixed-delay missing pose can prevent valid initiation; absence of a burst is not automatically a warhead failure.

theory.equations: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.
theory.states: Common release age/contact-consumption state; V0 proximity is stateless and has no pending-delay or turn-history mechanism. V1 additionally has contiguous per-target previous-boundary motion plus Fresh/Pending/Sealed fixed-delay state; resetRelease clears only the owning release state.
theory.inputs: Own sensor and target piecewise-linear captured paths with original offsets, native cutoff/contact coverage, this model radius/arming/lifetime and declared station.
theory.outputs: Validity, closest fraction/miss and trigger decision; World owns one causal captured-pose detonation and target attribution.
theory.discretization: Paths require first offset0 and strictly increasing finite offsets/positions. motionAt holds the final captured pose after path end. V0 bounds its sweep by eligibleEnd and own-path end, retaining target hold-at-last semantics for native stopped-target ownership; V1 additionally bounds by target-path end. These adapter semantics do not authorize inventing a future moving path; World supplies native target/contact/removal cutoffs.
theory.limits: Ideal geometric target detector, not RF/laser fuze electronics, scattering waveform, safe-arm mechanics or calibrated false alarm/discrimination. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: All23 swept-path cards share a software law, not sensor hardware; individual radius/lifetime and own release/target histories remain distinct.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.

sensitivity.effect: Radius uncertainty can flip the discrete decision; no smooth probability claim.
Timing and body-station uncertainty must be assessed with actual captured closing motion, not a scene-specific radius fit.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: All23 swept-path cards share a software law, not sensor hardware; individual radius/lifetime and own release/target histories remain distinct.
Time-armed geometric scene admits no RF/optical discrimination: a physically eligible decoy can trigger it.
V0 endpoint minimum differs materially from V1 actual-turn initiation; equal radius does not make AIM120D and AIM120C equivalent.
Capture gaps, removed-target cutoffs, arming/expiry tangencies and fixed-delay missing pose can prevent valid initiation; absence of a burst is not automatically a warhead failure.

If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. theory.states: Common release age/contact-consumption state; V0 proximity is stateless and has no pending-delay or turn-history mechanism. V1 additionally has contiguous per-target previous-boundary motion plus Fresh/Pending/Sealed fixed-delay state; resetRelease clears only the owning release state.
theory.inputs: Own sensor and target piecewise-linear captured paths with original offsets, native cutoff/contact coverage, this model radius/arming/lifetime and declared station.
theory.outputs: Validity, closest fraction/miss and trigger decision; World owns one causal captured-pose detonation and target attribution.
theory.discretization: Paths require first offset0 and strictly increasing finite offsets/positions. motionAt holds the final captured pose after path end. V0 bounds its sweep by eligibleEnd and own-path end, retaining target hold-at-last semantics for native stopped-target ownership; V1 additionally bounds by target-path end. These adapter semantics do not authorize inventing a future moving path; World supplies native target/contact/removal cutoffs.
theory.limits: Ideal geometric target detector, not RF/laser fuze electronics, scattering waveform, safe-arm mechanics or calibrated false alarm/discrimination. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

theory.equations: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.
theory.states: Common release age/contact-consumption state; V0 proximity is stateless and has no pending-delay or turn-history mechanism. V1 additionally has contiguous per-target previous-boundary motion plus Fresh/Pending/Sealed fixed-delay state; resetRelease clears only the owning release state.
theory.inputs: Own sensor and target piecewise-linear captured paths with original offsets, native cutoff/contact coverage, this model radius/arming/lifetime and declared station.
theory.outputs: Validity, closest fraction/miss and trigger decision; World owns one causal captured-pose detonation and target attribution.
theory.discretization: Paths require first offset0 and strictly increasing finite offsets/positions. motionAt holds the final captured pose after path end. V0 bounds its sweep by eligibleEnd and own-path end, retaining target hold-at-last semantics for native stopped-target ownership; V1 additionally bounds by target-path end. These adapter semantics do not authorize inventing a future moving path; World supplies native target/contact/removal cutoffs.
theory.limits: Ideal geometric target detector, not RF/laser fuze electronics, scattering waveform, safe-arm mechanics or calibrated false alarm/discrimination. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.
theory.delta: magic-2: selected version0, arming=1s, live end=45s, radius=10.5637059362m, delay=0s; captured CG sensor, zero delay, constrained-minimum sweep, explicit time-armed geometric scene independent of main seeker lock. Magic2 frontal detection and a historical multi-element description are not evidence for this scalar reticle. Pre-fragmented wording is represented by equivalent point fragments, not an authored preform map.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: All23 swept-path cards share a software law, not sensor hardware; individual radius/lifetime and own release/target histories remain distinct.
Time-armed geometric scene admits no RF/optical discrimination: a physically eligible decoy can trigger it.
V0 endpoint minimum differs materially from V1 actual-turn initiation; equal radius does not make AIM120D and AIM120C equivalent.
Capture gaps, removed-target cutoffs, arming/expiry tangencies and fixed-delay missing pose can prevent valid initiation; absence of a burst is not automatically a warhead failure.

theory.states: Common release age/contact-consumption state; V0 proximity is stateless and has no pending-delay or turn-history mechanism. theory.outputs: Validity, closest fraction/miss and trigger decision; World owns one causal captured-pose detonation and target attribution.
theory.discretization: Paths require first offset0 and strictly increasing finite offsets/positions. motionAt holds the final captured pose after path end. V0 bounds its sweep by eligibleEnd and own-path end, retaining target hold-at-last semantics for native stopped-target ownership; V1 additionally bounds by target-path end. theory.equations: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.
theory.states: Common release age/contact-consumption state; V0 proximity is stateless and has no pending-delay or turn-history mechanism. V1 additionally has contiguous per-target previous-boundary motion plus Fresh/Pending/Sealed fixed-delay state; resetRelease clears only the owning release state.
theory.inputs: Own sensor and target piecewise-linear captured paths with original offsets, native cutoff/contact coverage, this model radius/arming/lifetime and declared station.
theory.outputs: Validity, closest fraction/miss and trigger decision; World owns one causal captured-pose detonation and target attribution.
theory.discretization: Paths require first offset0 and strictly increasing finite offsets/positions. motionAt holds the final captured pose after path end. V0 bounds its sweep by eligibleEnd and own-path end, retaining target hold-at-last semantics for native stopped-target ownership; V1 additionally bounds by target-path end. These adapter semantics do not authorize inventing a future moving path; World supplies native target/contact/removal cutoffs.
theory.limits: Ideal geometric target detector, not RF/laser fuze electronics, scattering waveform, safe-arm mechanics or calibrated false alarm/discrimination. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

sensitivity.effect: Radius uncertainty can flip the discrete decision; no smooth probability claim.
Timing and body-station uncertainty must be assessed with actual captured closing motion, not a scene-specific radius fit.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: All23 swept-path cards share a software law, not sensor hardware; individual radius/lifetime and own release/target histories remain distinct.
Time-armed geometric scene admits no RF/optical discrimination: a physically eligible decoy can trigger it.
V0 endpoint minimum differs materially from V1 actual-turn initiation; equal radius does not make AIM120D and AIM120C equivalent.
Capture gaps, removed-target cutoffs, arming/expiry tangencies and fixed-delay missing pose can prevent valid initiation; absence of a burst is not automatically a warhead failure.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.

sensitivity.effect: Radius uncertainty can flip the discrete decision; no smooth probability claim.
Timing and body-station uncertainty must be assessed with actual captured closing motion, not a scene-specific radius fit.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: All23 swept-path cards share a software law, not sensor hardware; individual radius/lifetime and own release/target histories remain distinct.
Time-armed geometric scene admits no RF/optical discrimination: a physically eligible decoy can trigger it.
V0 endpoint minimum differs materially from V1 actual-turn initiation; equal radius does not make AIM120D and AIM120C equivalent.
Capture gaps, removed-target cutoffs, arming/expiry tangencies and fixed-delay missing pose can prevent valid initiation; absence of a burst is not automatically a warhead failure.

theory.states: Common release age/contact-consumption state; V0 proximity is stateless and has no pending-delay or turn-history mechanism. V1 additionally has contiguous per-target previous-boundary motion plus Fresh/Pending/Sealed fixed-delay state; resetRelease clears only the owning release state.
theory.inputs: Own sensor and target piecewise-linear captured paths with original offsets, native cutoff/contact coverage, this model radius/arming/lifetime and declared station.
theory.outputs: Validity, closest fraction/miss and trigger decision; World owns one causal captured-pose detonation and target attribution.
theory.discretization: Paths require first offset0 and strictly increasing finite offsets/positions. motionAt holds the final captured pose after path end. V0 bounds its sweep by eligibleEnd and own-path end, retaining target hold-at-last semantics for native stopped-target ownership; V1 additionally bounds by target-path end. These adapter semantics do not authorize inventing a future moving path; World supplies native target/contact/removal cutoffs.
theory.limits: Ideal geometric target detector, not RF/laser fuze electronics, scattering waveform, safe-arm mechanics or calibrated false alarm/discrimination. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. theory.equations: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.
theory.states: Common release age/contact-consumption state; V0 proximity is stateless and has no pending-delay or turn-history mechanism. V1 additionally has contiguous per-target previous-boundary motion plus Fresh/Pending/Sealed fixed-delay state; resetRelease clears only the owning release state.
theory.inputs: Own sensor and target piecewise-linear captured paths with original offsets, native cutoff/contact coverage, this model radius/arming/lifetime and declared station.
theory.outputs: Validity, closest fraction/miss and trigger decision; World owns one causal captured-pose detonation and target attribution.
theory.discretization: Paths require first offset0 and strictly increasing finite offsets/positions. motionAt holds the final captured pose after path end. V0 bounds its sweep by eligibleEnd and own-path end, retaining target hold-at-last semantics for native stopped-target ownership; V1 additionally bounds by target-path end. These adapter semantics do not authorize inventing a future moving path; World supplies native target/contact/removal cutoffs.
theory.limits: Ideal geometric target detector, not RF/laser fuze electronics, scattering waveform, safe-arm mechanics or calibrated false alarm/discrimination. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.
theory.delta: r-27er: selected version0, arming=1s, live end=110s, radius=13.2449979984m, delay=0s; captured CG sensor, zero delay, constrained-minimum sweep, explicit time-armed geometric scene independent of main seeker lock. Exact card variant and its own mass, charge, sensor and timing records are used. Shared code neither supplies undisclosed OEM internals nor establishes equipment equivalence.

sensitivity.effect: Radius uncertainty can flip the discrete decision; no smooth probability claim.
Timing and body-station uncertainty must be assessed with actual captured closing motion, not a scene-specific radius fit.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: All23 swept-path cards share a software law, not sensor hardware; individual radius/lifetime and own release/target histories remain distinct.
Time-armed geometric scene admits no RF/optical discrimination: a physically eligible decoy can trigger it.
V0 endpoint minimum differs materially from V1 actual-turn initiation; equal radius does not make AIM120D and AIM120C equivalent.
Capture gaps, removed-target cutoffs, arming/expiry tangencies and fixed-delay missing pose can prevent valid initiation; absence of a burst is not automatically a warhead failure.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.

sensitivity.effect: Radius uncertainty can flip the discrete decision; no smooth probability claim.
Timing and body-station uncertainty must be assessed with actual captured closing motion, not a scene-specific radius fit.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: All23 swept-path cards share a software law, not sensor hardware; individual radius/lifetime and own release/target histories remain distinct.
Time-armed geometric scene admits no RF/optical discrimination: a physically eligible decoy can trigger it.
V0 endpoint minimum differs materially from V1 actual-turn initiation; equal radius does not make AIM120D and AIM120C equivalent.
Capture gaps, removed-target cutoffs, arming/expiry tangencies and fixed-delay missing pose can prevent valid initiation; absence of a burst is not automatically a warhead failure.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.

sensitivity.effect: Radius uncertainty can flip the discrete decision; no smooth probability claim.
Timing and body-station uncertainty must be assessed with actual captured closing motion, not a scene-specific radius fit.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: All23 swept-path cards share a software law, not sensor hardware; individual radius/lifetime and own release/target histories remain distinct.
Time-armed geometric scene admits no RF/optical discrimination: a physically eligible decoy can trigger it.
V0 endpoint minimum differs materially from V1 actual-turn initiation; equal radius does not make AIM120D and AIM120C equivalent.
Capture gaps, removed-target cutoffs, arming/expiry tangencies and fixed-delay missing pose can prevent valid initiation; absence of a burst is not automatically a warhead failure.

theory.states: Common release age/contact-consumption state; V0 proximity is stateless and has no pending-delay or turn-history mechanism. V1 additionally has contiguous per-target previous-boundary motion plus Fresh/Pending/Sealed fixed-delay state; resetRelease clears only the owning release state.
theory.inputs: Own sensor and target piecewise-linear captured paths with original offsets, native cutoff/contact coverage, this model radius/arming/lifetime and declared station.
theory.outputs: Validity, closest fraction/miss and trigger decision; World owns one causal captured-pose detonation and target attribution.
theory.discretization: Paths require first offset0 and strictly increasing finite offsets/positions. motionAt holds the final captured pose after path end. V0 bounds its sweep by eligibleEnd and own-path end, retaining target hold-at-last semantics for native stopped-target ownership; V1 additionally bounds by target-path end. These adapter semantics do not authorize inventing a future moving path; World supplies native target/contact/removal cutoffs.
theory.limits: Ideal geometric target detector, not RF/laser fuze electronics, scattering waveform, safe-arm mechanics or calibrated false alarm/discrimination. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. theory.equations: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.
theory.states: Common release age/contact-consumption state; V0 proximity is stateless and has no pending-delay or turn-history mechanism. V1 additionally has contiguous per-target previous-boundary motion plus Fresh/Pending/Sealed fixed-delay state; resetRelease clears only the owning release state.
theory.inputs: Own sensor and target piecewise-linear captured paths with original offsets, native cutoff/contact coverage, this model radius/arming/lifetime and declared station.
theory.outputs: Validity, closest fraction/miss and trigger decision; World owns one causal captured-pose detonation and target attribution.
theory.discretization: Paths require first offset0 and strictly increasing finite offsets/positions. motionAt holds the final captured pose after path end. V0 bounds its sweep by eligibleEnd and own-path end, retaining target hold-at-last semantics for native stopped-target ownership; V1 additionally bounds by target-path end. These adapter semantics do not authorize inventing a future moving path; World supplies native target/contact/removal cutoffs.
theory.limits: Ideal geometric target detector, not RF/laser fuze electronics, scattering waveform, safe-arm mechanics or calibrated false alarm/discrimination. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.
theory.delta: r-37m: selected version0, arming=1s, live end=110s, radius=14.7459666924m, delay=0s; captured CG sensor, zero delay, constrained-minimum sweep, explicit time-armed geometric scene independent of main seeker lock. Exact card variant and its own mass, charge, sensor and timing records are used. Shared code neither supplies undisclosed OEM internals nor establishes equipment equivalence.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: All23 swept-path cards share a software law, not sensor hardware; individual radius/lifetime and own release/target histories remain distinct.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.

Capture gaps, removed-target cutoffs, arming/expiry tangencies and fixed-delay missing pose can prevent valid initiation; absence of a burst is not automatically a warhead failure.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.

sensitivity.effect: Radius uncertainty can flip the discrete decision; no smooth probability claim.
Timing and body-station uncertainty must be assessed with actual captured closing motion, not a scene-specific radius fit.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: All23 swept-path cards share a software law, not sensor hardware; individual radius/lifetime and own release/target histories remain distinct.
Time-armed geometric scene admits no RF/optical discrimination: a physically eligible decoy can trigger it.
V0 endpoint minimum differs materially from V1 actual-turn initiation; equal radius does not make AIM120D and AIM120C equivalent.
Capture gaps, removed-target cutoffs, arming/expiry tangencies and fixed-delay missing pose can prevent valid initiation; absence of a burst is not automatically a warhead failure.

theory.states: Common release age/contact-consumption state; V0 proximity is stateless and has no pending-delay or turn-history mechanism. V1 additionally has contiguous per-target previous-boundary motion plus Fresh/Pending/Sealed fixed-delay state; resetRelease clears only the owning release state.
theory.inputs: Own sensor and target piecewise-linear captured paths with original offsets, native cutoff/contact coverage, this model radius/arming/lifetime and declared station.
theory.outputs: Validity, closest fraction/miss and trigger decision; World owns one causal captured-pose detonation and target attribution.
theory.discretization: Paths require first offset0 and strictly increasing finite offsets/positions. motionAt holds the final captured pose after path end. V0 bounds its sweep by eligibleEnd and own-path end, retaining target hold-at-last semantics for native stopped-target ownership; V1 additionally bounds by target-path end. These adapter semantics do not authorize inventing a future moving path; World supplies native target/contact/removal cutoffs.
theory.limits: Ideal geometric target detector, not RF/laser fuze electronics, scattering waveform, safe-arm mechanics or calibrated false alarm/discrimination. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. theory.equations: For each merged captured relative segment r(u)=r0+u*d, d=r1-r0. If d dot d>0, u0=-(r0 dot d)/(d dot d); otherwise V0 chooses the first eligible fraction and V1 stationary overlap supplies no turn. The active interval is [armingS,lifeS), further cut off by native eligibility/contact. V0 takes the globally smallest constrained miss over merged segments, keeping the earliest exact tie; this is not first entry into the radius. V1 admits an analytic stationary point at an eligible initial/interior/final captured endpoint, including the final endpoint if its unconstrained stationary point is exactly represented there; a merely clamped approaching endpoint is not a turn. Initial-point deduplication/two-sided eligibility belongs to contiguous per-target history. V1 additionally admits a captured corner when r dot leftMovement<=0 and r dot rightMovement>=0, with previous actual motion; all candidate launch ages must remain inside the armed/live interval. Native fractions remain normalized to the original whole decision duration. Radius classification is miss<=radius; expiry is exclusive and an expiry-only tangency is excluded before any representable-live-age adjustment.
theory.states: Common release age/contact-consumption state; V0 proximity is stateless and has no pending-delay or turn-history mechanism. V1 additionally has contiguous per-target previous-boundary motion plus Fresh/Pending/Sealed fixed-delay state; resetRelease clears only the owning release state.
theory.inputs: Own sensor and target piecewise-linear captured paths with original offsets, native cutoff/contact coverage, this model radius/arming/lifetime and declared station.
theory.outputs: Validity, closest fraction/miss and trigger decision; World owns one causal captured-pose detonation and target attribution.
theory.discretization: Paths require first offset0 and strictly increasing finite offsets/positions. motionAt holds the final captured pose after path end. V0 bounds its sweep by eligibleEnd and own-path end, retaining target hold-at-last semantics for native stopped-target ownership; V1 additionally bounds by target-path end. These adapter semantics do not authorize inventing a future moving path; World supplies native target/contact/removal cutoffs.
theory.limits: Ideal geometric target detector, not RF/laser fuze electronics, scattering waveform, safe-arm mechanics or calibrated false alarm/discrimination. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.
theory.delta: super-530d: selected version0, arming=1s, live end=110s, radius=12.4772255751m, delay=0s; captured CG sensor, zero delay, constrained-minimum sweep, explicit time-armed geometric scene independent of main seeker lock. The card explicitly inherits Super530F warhead information; exact D case geometry and fragment distribution remain inferred.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: All23 swept-path cards share a software law, not sensor hardware; individual radius/lifetime and own release/target histories remain distinct.
Time-armed geometric scene admits no RF/optical discrimination: a physically eligible decoy can trigger it.
V0 endpoint minimum differs materially from V1 actual-turn initiation; equal radius does not make AIM120D and AIM120C equivalent.
Capture gaps, removed-target cutoffs, arming/expiry tangencies and fixed-delay missing pose can prevent valid initiation; absence of a burst is not automatically a warhead failure.
